text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking with Yamanin Zephyr, we spotted Nishino Flower gazing at a flower bed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Even the very last flower... has withered.
...Thank you for everything. You did well."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Flower-san, are you tending to the flowers?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Yes. The flowers around here... have already passed their season, so all their petals have fallen, but..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see... The balmy breeze from when the flowers were in full bloom still vividly comes to mind, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san... Thank you so much.
I'm sure the flowers are happy
to hear you say that too...!
choice_data_list: I was finding comfort in it too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Trainer...
...It really is lonely, isn't it?
To think we won't get to see it anymore...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then... why don't we set it to Nature,
so that we can always be together?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
While looking back on our memories...
let us stir up a favorable seasonal wind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr picks up the fallen petals.
Nishino Flower follows her lead. And after
gathering the petals scattered across the flowerbed—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Um, what are we going to do now?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Even after flowers fall, they can become a bright breeze once more. Allow me to transform them into an elegant form.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
First, put the water and those flower petals
from earlier into the pot, then place it over the heat.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Are you going to boil the petals?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Could this be plant dyeing?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us dye this white handkerchief.
...And turn the calm once more into a gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...I wish to feel that floral wind once again as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A vivid... cheerful breeze.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Vibrant and cheerful—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Wah...! The flowers are blooming!
Ehehe, I'm so glad."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Everything's taken on such bright colors now.
...Ehehe, just looking at it makes me feel energized somehow."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to dye it with the same bright colors
as back when this flower was full of life."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Basking in all that sunlight,
into that bright, sparkling color...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I remember it too.
It was a truly dazzling, brilliant wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then let us dye it swiftly.
If we take too long, the color will turn dull.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I swear I will dye it beautifully...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I have a feeling the fragrant breeze will brush against my cheeks once again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Did you give this flower a name?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A name... Now that you mention it, it doesn't have one.
...What would you name it, Zephyr-san?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Watching you warmed my heart.
You're like a "cozy ray of sunshine," aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Pokapoka...!
Hehehe... That's a lovely name.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after dyeing the handkerchiefs, we returned to
that flower bed while waiting for them to dry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Mr. Pokapoka, I was able to make such a pretty handkerchief.
...Now we can always be together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Scattered blossoms turn to seed, and life comes full circle.
...Let us connect them to a fresh breath of life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, Yamanin Zephyr began sowing seeds into the flowerbed—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what kind of flower will bloom.
I'm already waiting on the breeze with anticipation.
choice_data_list: I'm sure it'll take strong root.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: May it grow big and strong...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then we'll be needing some good fertilizer.
Shall we go ask for some from the fields?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spurred by their eager anticipation,
Yamanin Zephyr and the others hurried off
to fetch the fertilizer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because the soil is in great condition.
Look... even the wiggly worms are full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's huge...
...Mr. Earthworm, please take good care of the flowers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Imagining a future where powerful blossoms bloom magnificently, Yamanin Zephyr and the others laughed together.
